NSLOCTEXT("[0FC79C2BA5B0676EEB24B0C0D3C4C593]", "10E053D0465D6953FE40179AB328FE73", "Aye. I'll give you some of my healing salve, which you can use on travelers here in the caves.

There should be some up ahead that you can help. It's not as good as a cleric, but it will eventually heal them enough so they may return to the portal for rest.

Willing to assist?")
